<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const researchersHistoryList = document.getElementById('researchers-history-list');
  if (!researchersHistoryList) return;

  function updateResearchersHistory() {
    let history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('affinedrift_researchers_history') || '[]');
    
    const currentPage = {
      title: document.title.replace(' - AffineDrift', '').replace('AffineDrift - ', ''),
      url: window.location.pathname.split('/').pop() || 'resources-researchers.html'
    };

    if (currentPage.url === 'resources-researchers.html') {
      history = history.filter(item => item.url !== currentPage.url);
      history.unshift(currentPage);
      history = history.slice(0, 10);
      localStorage.setItem('affinedrift_researchers_history', JSON.stringify(history));
    }

    if (history.length === 0) {
      researchersHistoryList.textContent = '';
      const li = document.createElement('li');
      li.className = 'history-empty';
      li.textContent = 'No recent researchers yet';
      researchersHistoryList.appendChild(li);
      return;
    }

    researchersHistoryList.textContent = '';
    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
    history.forEach((item) => {
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = typeof item.url === "string" && !item.url.replace(/[\x00-\x20]/g, "").toLowerCase().startsWith("javascript:") ? item.url : "#";
      a.textContent = item.title;
      li.appendChild(a);
      fragment.appendChild(li);
    });
    researchersHistoryList.appendChild(fragment);
  }

  updateResearchersHistory();
});
</script>
